source_annotation.prompt: Pick up the orange and place it into the container.

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to reach the orange beside the white basket, close its thumb and fingers around it, and lift it. It carries the orange over the basket, lowers it inside, and opens its hand to release it onto the basket floor. The hand then rises out and withdraws to the lower right, leaving the orange in the basket. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
